bounded_first_proof_scope.selector_policy: Select from source-proof event counts where tick_size_change_rows == 0, book_rows > 0, price_change_rows > 0, last_trade_price_rows > 0, and replay_rows <= configured row budget; order by replay_rows ASC then asset_id ASC.
claim_limits: Does not prove dynamic tick-size replay.
Does not prove assets with tick_size_change rows.
Does not prove full PMXT Polymarket L2 source acceptance.

hard_stop_audit.evidence: Raw object and hash are fixed in the pending PMXT fixture and first-proof policy; source proof remains pending until TDD produces NT mapping, catalog read-back, BacktestNode, storage, coverage, and cost evidence.
hard_stop_audit.required_before_acceptance: Promote or supersede the pending fixture only after the bounded selected universe is written to NT catalog, queried back, and consumed by BacktestNode.

hard_stop_audit.evidence: Contract requires one configured artifact_root with typed nt-catalog/source-proofs/backtests subpaths; implementation must create a new projection id/run id and fail closed on any dirty prefix.
hard_stop_audit.required_before_acceptance: TDD must prove clean local artifact_root staging first, then any publish path must use configured artifact_root and create-only semantics.

hard_stop_audit.evidence: Current catalog projection fails closed on dirty catalog roots for TradeTick; bounded PMXT L2 must extend the same dirty-prefix, manifest/checkpoint, and logical-hash checks to BinaryOption, OrderBookDelta, and TradeTick.
hard_stop_audit.required_before_acceptance: RED/GREEN tests for dirty output rejection, mismatched source proof/hash/converter identity rejection, idempotent rerun, and invalid checkpoint refusal.

hard_stop_audit.required_before_acceptance: BTE must depend on pinned nautilus-polymarket and prove direct parser/provider reuse; build_polymarket_trade_id is crate-private and needs a tested mirror or upstream public API.

hard_stop_audit.required_before_acceptance: BacktestResultContract must preserve PMXT source proof id/version, accepted object hash, selected universe hash, conversion manifest/checkpoint hash, logical catalog hash, NT revision, and claim limits.

nt_use_matrix_delta.requirement: PMXT archive rows to NT data

nt_use_matrix_delta.evidence: BacktestNode dispatches OrderBookDelta catalog queries and validates L2_MBP venues have configured order-book data.
nt_use_matrix_delta.decision: Use NT BacktestNode. No custom simulation engine.

nt_use_matrix_delta.evidence: NT live Polymarket path rebuilds BinaryOption and emits DataEvent::Instrument, but BacktestDataConfig catalog replay feeds Data enum records and Data has no InstrumentAny variant.

nt_use_matrix_delta.evidence: Source-proof acceptance, artifact_root path governance, clean-prefix checks, logical catalog hash, selected universe hash, and claim limits are Bolt contract surfaces.
nt_use_matrix_delta.decision: Bolt owns minimal gates and provenance only.
